coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same high‑severity issues for broad coverage: they lack introductory context, focus narrowly on the 737 MAX settlement and a few related incidents, omit a comprehensive description of the various fraudulent tactics Boeing employed (e.g., false‑claims billing, procurement manipulation, kickbacks), and present information as a superficial list of cases.
